bugs.error_message: Mint CTA button rendered with wrong text color; `text-base` resolved as a font-size utility instead of the custom color.
bugs.root_cause: Named a Tailwind v4 @theme color token `--color-base`, which produces `text-base` / `bg-base` utilities that collide with Tailwind's built-in `text-base` font-size utility.
bugs.fix: Renamed the page-background token to `--color-void` (`bg-void` / `text-void`) in src/index.css and updated usages.

bugs.error_message: Hero paragraph lost its font size — `text-base` became `text-void`.
bugs.root_cause: Ran a file-wide `sed s/text-base/text-void/g` while renaming a color token. The pattern also matched a legitimate Tailwind font-size class on an unrelated element.
bugs.fix: Restored `text-base` on the hero paragraph with a scoped sed anchored on surrounding classes; verified every remaining hit by grep.

bugs.error_message: /usr/bin/bash: -c: line 153: unexpected EOF while looking for matching `'
bugs.root_cause: Wrote a large TSX/TS content file containing prose with apostrophes and em dashes through a bash quoted heredoc; the shell mis-parsed the quoting.
bugs.fix: Used the Write tool for prose-heavy source files instead of heredocs; used a small node script for targeted string replacements afterward.

bugs.error_message: og.png headline rendered in a serif font instead of Satoshi.
bugs.root_cause: sharp's librsvg backend does not load @font-face declarations that embed woff2 as a base64 data URI; it silently falls back to a default serif.
bugs.fix: Switched scripts/og.mjs to a system font stack ('Segoe UI' / Consolas) so the rendered card is sans-serif and on-brand.

bugs.error_message: Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'C:\tmp\fs.css'
bugs.root_cause: Git Bash maps /tmp to its own temp root, but Node resolves the literal path '/tmp/...' to C:\tmp on Windows.
bugs.fix: Wrote intermediates to the session scratchpad directory and passed absolute paths into node via argv.

bugs.error_message: All three duotone portrait variants rendered identically as plain black and white; .tint() had no visible effect.
bugs.root_cause: sharp .grayscale() leaves the pipeline single-band, so a following .tint() has no colour channels to act on and is silently a no-op.
bugs.fix: Render the grayscale stage to a buffer with .toColourspace("srgb").png(), then reload it and map luminance to shadow/highlight colours with a per-channel .linear(aArray, bArray). This is a real duotone rather than a tint.

bugs.error_message: Error: Band expansion using linear is unsupported
bugs.root_cause: Called .linear() with three-element arrays on a pipeline that was still single-band after .grayscale(); .toColourspace("srgb") does not materialise three bands until the pipeline is executed.
bugs.fix: Split into two passes — write the grayscale image to a PNG buffer first (which does materialise 3 channels), then apply the per-channel .linear() to the reloaded buffer.

bugs.error_message: Read tool rendered a .jfif photo as thousands of lines of binary text instead of an image.
bugs.root_cause: .jfif is a JPEG but the extension is not in the image allowlist, so the file was treated as text.
bugs.fix: Converted the source to PNG with sharp into the scratchpad first, then read that to view it. Always convert unusual image extensions before reading.
